en: Fixed `/login` reporting "Login successful" when credentials could not be saved to secure storage; it now shows the failure, and offers a retry when the new login didn't take effect (anthropics/claude-code#73861)
zh: 修复了凭据无法保存到安全存储时 `/login` 仍报告“Login successful”的问题；现在会显示失败，并在新登录未生效时提供重试（anthropics/claude-code#73861）
